_provenance: OpenAI Whisper models converted to whisper.cpp's ggml format by the whisper.cpp project, published at https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (downloaded from there at run time, never bundled).

sha1: the SHA-1 published in whisper.cpp v1.9.5's models/README.md (native/third_party/whisper.cpp/models/README.md, 'Available models'): tiny bd577a113a864445d4c299885e0cb97d4ba92b5f, base 465707469ff3a37a2b9b8d8f89f2f99de7299dac.
size: exact bytes of the published files (75 MiB / 141 MiB), confirmed against what Hugging Face serves by CI (tool/check_model_downloads.py).

sha256: the SHA-256 Hugging Face reports for the files (X-Linked-Etag); the app checks it as well as sha1 (a download from a mirror must match both), and CI compares it with what Hugging Face serves on every run.
Weights: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI (https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/LICENSE). The files are F16 and multilingual (99 languages).

silero-vad (kind vad): Silero VAD v6.2.0 (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020-present Silero Team, https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad) converted to ggml by whisper.cpp (models/convert-silero-vad-to-ggml.py), published at https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/whisper-vad (whisper.cpp's models/download-vad-model.sh). size, sha1 and sha256 are those of the copy whisper.cpp v1.9.5 ships for its tests (native/third_party/whisper.cpp/models/for-tests-silero-v6.2.0-ggml.bin, the real model: 864.35 KiB as in whisper.cpp's README download log); CI compares size and sha256 with what Hugging Face serves (tool/check_model_downloads.py).

Quantized models (base-q5_1, small-q5_1, large-v3-turbo-q5_0): whisper.cpp's quantization of the same OpenAI weights (q5_1, q5_0), published in the same repository; url pinned to commit 5359861c739e955e79d9a303bcbc70fb988958b1, size and sha256 from Hugging Face's API (the Git LFS object) and checked against the downloaded file, sha1 computed from it (tool/whisper_catalog.py resolve, in the CI job 'Check model downloads'; whisper.cpp's models/README.md SHA-1 compared where listed). minRamMb: the RAM below which the app does not offer the model (small: 4 GB phones, large-v3-turbo: 8 GB).
license: OpenAI Whisper model weights: MIT License (Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI)
